cf22f409679e6ef6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اقوات للصناعات الغذائية عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على الإشراف الهندسي وإعداد التصاميم والمخططات الإنشائية، بالإضافة إلى متابعة تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع لتحديد الاحتياجات الإنشائية. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية المستخدمة في المشاريع. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع ومطابقة جميع الأعمال للمواصفات والمعايير المعتمدة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة المدنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسبة تقدمها، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل المواقع الإنشائية. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد وتدقيق التصاميم والمخططات الإنشائية. القدرة على الإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع وضمان الجودة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق عمل متخصص في شركة اقوات للصناعات الغذائية. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل داعمة تتيح للمهندس المدني المساهمة بفعالية في مشاريعها الإنشائية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال مراحل المقابلة.

cfa8548c0aae1ad9.description: About the Role Ericsson is seeking a Regional Manager – Technical Building Management (TBM) for a full-time position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with responsibilities extending to Dammam. This leadership role involves overseeing end-to-end Operations and Maintenance (O&M) for all assigned stc technical buildings and mission-critical data centers. The position requires deep expertise in critical facilities management, electromechanical systems, and enterprise maintenance workflows. Key Responsibilities The Regional Manager will lead regional field and monitoring teams to ensure 100% infrastructure uptime, strict SLA compliance, energy efficiency, and seamless stakeholder coordination with stc. Specific responsibilities include: Directing monthly execution of Preventive Maintenance (PM) schedules across electromechanical assets, HVAC, power systems, civil infrastructure, janitorial/housekeeping, and technical room cleaning, in compliance with stc systems (IFSM). Planning and executing specialized maintenance operations and standby support for critical seasonal peaks and national events across the Kingdom, including Hajj, Ramadan, Saudi National Day, Foundation Day, and major international events. Supervising site rehabilitation works and actively participating in acceptance, testing, and commissioning activities. Attending Preliminary Acceptance Testing (PAT) and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), verifying system readiness, signing off on PAT documentation, and maintaining accurate updates in NPTS/BPM systems. Critical Infrastructure and Energy Management This role is responsible for driving energy efficiency and managing critical assets: Driving a minimum 5% year-on-year energy reduction against established power consumption baselines. Continuously monitoring, managing, and reporting Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) trends across all data centers and technical facilities. Auditing and validating stc electricity invoices by cross-referencing digital meter readings and existing load-monitoring systems. Developing and maintaining a structured asset database across all technical buildings in accordance with corporate Asset Management policies. Overseeing full asset lifecycle tracking, from QR code deployment and tagging of newly commissioned equipment to timely system updates for dismantled assets. Reporting, Documentation, and HSE Compliance The Regional Manager ensures comprehensive reporting, accurate documentation, and adherence to safety standards: Issuing periodic Technical Buildings Health Status Reports, incorporating mandatory trackers such as the Power Tracker, HVAC Redundancy Report, Trouble Ticket Root Cause (TT RC) Analysis, and Preventive Maintenance Reports (PMR). Ensuring all Single Line Diagrams (SLDs), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and Contingency Plans are accurate from upstream to downstream, updated in designated digital tools, and accessible on-site. Enforcing strict site safety standards and industry best practices, including thorough review and approval of Work Permits and site authorizations. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with operational oversight in Dammam. The role involves leading regional field and monitoring teams within a critical infrastructure environment.

cf01ac7efa271ef8.job_title: Senior Manager Cost Planning Master Development (SPA )
cf01ac7efa271ef8.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking an experienced and analytical individual to join its team as a Manager - Cost Planning. This full-time role is essential for establishing a world-class entertainment destination in Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will be responsible for building construction costs, devising and overseeing pre-contract cost management strategies, and ensuring that all financial aspects of projects align with the organization's overall budget and strategic goals. Key Responsibilities Proactively manage cost planning by understanding the cost versus value equation to ensure optimal financial outcomes without compromising project goals. Oversee the monthly tracker for scope and cost movements from previous project phases. Assist in reviewing cost plans submitted by Cost Consultants for accuracy and design alignment. Monitor and analyze design efficiencies as projects progress, ensuring third-party Cost Consultants adhere to defined scope of work, guidelines, and procedures. Ensure strict adherence to defined policies and processes, maintaining a thorough understanding of IPMS measurement guidelines. Provide internal updates to the Business Unit on the status of construction costs and design metrics. Ensure representation during internal reviews to facilitate progress and successfully pass through Stage Gates. Integrate design metrics with cost positions through benchmarking, ensuring assurance throughout all phases of the project lifecycle. Maintain awareness of feasibility requirements related to cost planning. Qualifications and Experience 5-7 years of relevant Cost Planning experience (Cost Planning, Quantity Surveying, Estimating). Local GCC experience, with 2 or more years in the GCC construction industry, is preferred. Expertise with industry standards such as NRM, CESSM, RIBA, POMI. Experience working on large-scale projects with a construction value greater than 200 million SAR. Familiarity with benchmarking cost and design. Experience with costs and benchmarking in KSA or the Middle East is preferable. Required Skills Proficiency in using Cost Planning Software; CostX is preferred. Basic ability to convey information clearly. Experience in adapting messages for different audiences. Company Overview Qiddiya Investment Company is dedicated to establishing a world-class entertainment destination in Saudi Arabia, contributing to the region's economic development and cultural enrichment. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply to join our team and contribute to this significant project.

cf27fe20d2c281ff.company_name: Applus+ Asia Middle East and Africa

cf5ac0a9b389a2b5.description: نبحث عن بائع قطع غيار سيارات متحمس للانضمام إلى فريقنا، يمتلك شغفاً بالسيارات وخبرة في مبيعات قطع الغيار. ستكون مسؤولاً عن مساعدة العملاء في العثور على القطع المناسبة لسياراتهم، وإدارة المخزون، وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات. إذا كنت تمتلك مهارات تواصل ممتازة وقدرة على العمل في بيئة سريعة الوتيرة، ندعوك للتقديم. * تقديم المشورة للعملاء حول قطع غيار السيارات واحتياجاتهم. * تحديد وتوفير قطع الغيار المطلوبة بدقة وكفاءة. * المساهمة في إدارة المخزون وعمليات الجرد الدورية. * تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتقديم خدمة عملاء استثنائية.

cf98b62a8eeb26cc.description: About the Role Müller`s Solutions is seeking a Senior ServiceNow SecOps Business Analyst to lead requirements gathering and process design for ServiceNow Security Operations (SecOps). This full-time role involves working closely with security teams, SOC analysts, and technical consultants to translate security processes into effective ServiceNow solutions across Security Incident Response, Vulnerability Response, and related modules. Candidates should have 5-10 years of experience, with a mandatory focus on hands-on business analysis experience in ServiceNow SecOps implementations. Key Responsibilities Conduct workshops with security, SOC, and IT stakeholders to gather and document business requirements. Analyze current security processes and design future-state workflows within ServiceNow SecOps. Develop clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional specifications. Map requirements to ServiceNow SecOps capabilities, including Security Incident Response (SIR), Vulnerability Response (VR), Configuration Compliance, and Threat Intelligence. Collaborate with technical consultants and developers to ensure solutions meet business needs. Support integration requirements with various security tools such as SIEM, vulnerability scanners, and EDR. Define security KPIs, SLAs, dashboards, and reporting requirements. Assist with User Acceptance Testing (UAT) planning and execution, training, and change management activities. Manage the backlog and prioritize requirements in collaboration with product owners. Act as the primary liaison between business, security, and technical teams. Qualifications and Requirements A minimum of 6 years of experience as a Business Analyst, with significant experience on ServiceNow. Mandatory: Hands-on business analysis experience on ServiceNow SecOps (SIR and/or VR) implementations. Strong understanding of security operations processes, including incident response, vulnerability management, threat intelligence, and SOC workflows. Knowledge of security frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, and MITRE ATT&CK. Experience in writing user stories and functional specifications within Agile environments (*, Jira, ServiceNow Agile). Familiarity with security tools such as Splunk, QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or CrowdStrike. Excellent communication, workshop facilitation, and stakeholder management skills. Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field. Preferred Qualifications ServiceNow certifications, including CSA, CIS – Security Incident Response, or CIS – Vulnerability Response. Business analysis certifications such as CBAP, CCBA, or PMI-PBA. Experience in banking, government, or other regulated sectors, particularly within the UAE/GCC region. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this full-time position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

cfda5a371e6f5065.description: About the Role Advansys is seeking an experienced Enterprise Architect to define, develop, and maintain the organization's enterprise architecture strategy. This full-time role involves aligning business objectives with IT strategies, designing scalable technology solutions, and ensuring the effective integration of enterprise systems and applications. The ideal candidate will have 5-10 years of experience in enterprise architecture frameworks, IT governance, cloud technologies, digital transformation, and large-scale enterprise solutions. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain the organization's enterprise architecture strategy, roadmap, and standards. Align IT architecture with business objectives and long-term organizational goals. Design and oversee enterprise-wide technology architectures, including applications, infrastructure, data, and integration. Define architectural principles, guidelines, and best practices across IT projects. Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that support business growth and digital transformation. Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and high-performance enterprise solutions. Ensure seamless integration between enterprise applications, platforms, and systems. Collaborate with business stakeholders, IT leadership, solution architects, and development teams. Establish and enforce IT architecture governance, standards, and compliance requirements. Identify technology risks, architectural gaps, and opportunities for optimization. Oversee technology modernization initiatives, cloud adoption, and enterprise transformation projects. cf3dacdddaedce4d.description: About the Role CEER is seeking a Specialist Tax to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for supporting tax compliance and reporting activities, ensuring adherence to ZATCA regulations and internal policies. The Specialist Tax will contribute to accurate financial reporting and mitigate tax risks for the company. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this position is to prepare and review tax filings, maintain accurate tax records, and assist in tax calculations, reconciliations, audits, and documentation. The role ensures CEER’s full compliance with applicable tax law and supports the overall financial integrity of the organization. Key Responsibilities Assist in the preparation and filing of all required tax returns, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely submission in line with CEER’s standards and regulatory requirements. Support the review and reconciliation of tax balances recorded in the general ledger, ensuring correctness and alignment with financial records. Prepare regular tax reports (yearly, quarterly, and monthly) for internal stakeholders and support submissions to the Zakat, Tax, and Customs Authority (ZATCA). Calculate and prepare tax adjustments, zakat base calculations, withholding tax computations, and VAT reconciliations to ensure compliance and optimization. Prepare documentation required for tax audits and inquiries by ZATCA, ensuring timely responses and proper representation. Maintain accurate and organized tax documentation, including records of filings, correspondence with authorities, and supporting schedules. Coordinate with internal departments to gather data required for tax filings and reporting. Assist in implementing tax compliance controls and procedures, ensuring adherence to CEER’s internal policies and regulatory requirements. Support tax risk identification by highlighting discrepancies, compliance gaps, or areas requiring clarification or corrective action. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 0-1 year of relevant experience. Work Setting This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, contributing to the financial operations of CEER. Application Process Salary details for this position will be disclosed during the application process.

cf1c6f56570b825a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة فرزه التجارية عن فني نظارات للانضمام إلى فريقها في بريدة، القصيم. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وتعديل وسائل المساعدة البصرية وفقًا للوصفات الطبية، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الإرشادات اللازمة للعملاء حول استخدامها والمحافظة عليها. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب وسائل المساعدة البصرية وضبط مقاساتها بدقة حسب الوصفات الطبية المقدمة من أخصائيي البصريات وأطباء العيون. تحديد العدسات المناسبة بناءً على مستوى النظر وتفسير الوصفات الطبية. تحديد تفضيلات العميل وطلب تصنيع عدسات النظارات بناءً على هذه التفضيلات. تقديم المشورة للعملاء حول اختيار النظارات والإطارات ووسائل المساعدة البصرية الأخرى. إرشاد العملاء حول كيفية تنظيف وصيانة النظارات ووسائل المساعدة البصرية للحفاظ عليها. تعيين زوايا الرؤية بدقة لضمان إحداث العدسات لتأثير إيجابي على رؤية المرضى. التقيد بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة المعتمدة في بيئة العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير الوصفات الطبية بدقة. مهارات تواصل جيدة لتقديم المشورة للعملاء بفعالية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني النظارات ضمن فريق مؤسسة فرزه التجارية في مدينة بريدة بمنطقة القصيم. الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب الالتزام بمعايير الجودة وخدمة العملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

cf2699b0f5fee4bf.description: About the Role Standard Chartered is seeking a Relationship Manager, Priority Banking, to join its team. This permanent position involves managing and developing relationships with high-profile clients to support business growth and achieve the bank's strategic objectives. The role focuses on delivering exceptional customer service through financial solutions while adhering to operational risk and regulatory requirements. Wealth and Retail Banking Overview The Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) division serves over 11 million clients across various fast-growing markets. This client base ranges from Mass Retail to Affluent, including high-net-worth clients managed by the Private Bank. WRB utilizes digital banking channels combined with personalized service to offer differentiated products and services such as deposits, payments, financing, wealth management, and tailored advice. The division also supports small business clients with their banking needs. Key Responsibilities Provide outstanding client experiences. Organize, follow up on leads, complete and record appointments, and close customer requests. Support clients in meeting their financial needs as they progress through their career and life stages. Build long-term relationships and understand clients' financial needs and aspirations to grow, manage, and protect their wealth with appropriate investment solutions. Stay informed about market trends, new product offerings, and the latest campaigns. Compensation and Benefits In line with its Fair Pay Charter, Standard Chartered offers a competitive salary and benefits package designed to support mental, physical, financial, and social wellbeing. This includes core bank funding for retirement savings, medical, and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in certain locations. Employee Support and Development Time-off benefits include annual leave, parental/maternity leave (20 weeks), sabbatical (up to 12 months), and volunteering leave (3 days), with a minimum global standard of 30 days for annual and public holidays combined. Flexible working options are available, based on home and office locations, with various working patterns. Proactive wellbeing support is provided through Unmind, a digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and human skills, a global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders, and self-help toolkits. A continuous learning culture supports growth, offering opportunities to reskill and upskill, with access to physical, virtual, and digital learning resources. Organizational Culture Standard Chartered is an inclusive and values-driven organization that embraces and celebrates diversity across its teams, business functions, and geographies, ensuring that every individual feels respected and can realize their full potential.

cf548cfb208d8d8d.job_title: Senior Design Manager Public Realm MAS
cf548cfb208d8d8d.description: About the Role Qiddiya is seeking a Director - Public Realm to lead the planning, design governance, and delivery oversight of public realm projects across multiple districts. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires over 10 years of experience. The role involves providing strategic and technical leadership to ensure that parks, streetscapes, public open spaces, and associated public realm assets are delivered in accordance with approved masterplans, citywide standards, Stage Gate requirements, and programme objectives. Key Responsibilities Lead public realm planning and design management for assigned districts and strategic projects. Provide design governance and technical assurance across CMP, DMP, Land Servicing, and detailed design stages. Oversee consultant performance, design reviews, and delivery of public realm packages. Ensure compliance with Qiddiya Vision, City Framework Plan, Public Realm Design Manual (PRDM), development controls, and citywide public realm standards. Coordinate integration of public realm with infrastructure, mobility, utilities, irrigation, sustainability, and operational requirements. Support Stage Gate submissions and provide executive-level recommendations on design, programme, risks, and delivery strategy. Manage and mentor multidisciplinary public realm teams, supporting capability development and succession planning. Lead stakeholder engagement with District Development Teams, Delivery Partners, consultants, and internal Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). Contribute to citywide public realm strategies, standards development, phasing plans, and operational readiness initiatives. Accountabilities Delivery of high-quality, standards-compliant public realm designs. Timely support of district programmes and Stage Gate approvals. Effective management of consultant teams and design budgets. Successful implementation of citywide public realm standards and governance processes. Proactive identification and mitigation of design, programme, and delivery risks. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. The position requires a strong understanding of public realm planning, design governance, and project delivery oversight. Work Environment and Collaboration The Director - Public Realm will support the implementation of citywide initiatives, including the Public Realm Design Manual (PRDM), People First Principles, and project spirit teams. This role acts as a key interface between district teams, consultants, infrastructure teams, and other business units, requiring strong collaboration and communication skills within a dynamic project environment in Riyadh.

cf9ef5a6aa906343.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة باكو إنجنيرينق التجارية عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال، وإعداد برامج التشغيل والصيانة للمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تطوير مخططات ومواصفات لخطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية، وتحديد مساراتها بدقة. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل التشغيلية. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية، ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. وضع برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات الفنية. المساهمة في تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل، ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة ببرامج تشغيل المعدات الكهربائية وتشخيص الأعطال. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق متخصص يعمل على مشاريع الهندسة الكهربائية المتنوعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

cfd18a72bc4967ff.job_title: Communication interfaces data loggers and IEDs
cfd18a72bc4967ff.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking a Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC) professional to join their team in Riyadh. This is a full-time position suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on the on-site commissioning and integration of automation and protection systems. Validate communication protocols including Modbus, IEC 61850, IEC 104, and DNP3. Coordinate with system integrators, OEM vendors, and internal teams to ensure seamless integration of automation and protection systems. Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to control signals, communication links, and data reporting. Ensure system compliance with client requirements and utility/grid code standards. Generate commissioning test reports, punch point lists, and comprehensive documentation. Support remote SCADA integration and participate in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) as required. Provide training and technical support to site Operations & Maintenance (O&M) staff during system handover. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 0-1 years of relevant experience in Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC) or a related field. Familiarity with I/O checks, loop testing, and logic verification is essential. Experience with SCADA HMI validation and communication protocols such as Modbus, IEC 61850, IEC 104, and DNP3 is required. Required Skills Strong troubleshooting abilities for control signals, communication links, and data reporting. Ability to coordinate effectively with various stakeholders, including system integrators and OEM vendors. Proficiency in generating technical reports and documentation. Capability to provide technical support and training. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh and involves on-site work, requiring coordination with various teams and external partners to ensure project success. The position is full-time. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time position with Larsen & Toubro in Riyadh. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

cfdb8c45e1fee939.description: About the Role Afaq - Warehouse Branch is seeking an Operations Executive (AlQassim) for Amazon Now. This full-time role is part of a newly established organization focused on designing and launching new business models across the AMET region. The successful candidate will join a team dedicated to redefining fast delivery services and building out new operations for customers in Riyadh and Al Qassim. Role Context and Objectives The Operations Executive will play a key role in the Amazon Now operations, specifically within the Under the Roof (UTR) and On the Road (OTR) operations in KSA. الشركة وإجراءات البيع والتحصيل النقدي. إعداد تقارير الأداء اليومية والأسبوعية والشهرية ورفعها للإدارة العليا. تطوير الأعمال والعلاقات التجارية اقتراح مواقع جديدة للبوثات أو الفروع وفقًا لتحليل حركة cf66bf86451e15a1.description: About the Role DP World Jeddah is seeking an experienced Vessel Planner Advance Planning to join their Planning team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is critical for optimizing vessel stowage and crane planning to enhance vessel productivity, berth performance, and overall terminal efficiency. Key Responsibilities Review vessel profiles, ship structures, stack weights, reefer slots, hatch covers, and vessel limitations to validate planning inputs and identify constraints. Analyze BAPLIE, MOVINS, TOS data, and other planning information; investigate discrepancies, assess operational impact, and coordinate resolutions with stakeholders. Develop, validate, and optimize vessel stowage plans and crane programs in line with vessel stability, cargo requirements, terminal equipment capability, and operational procedures. Identify opportunities to improve twin lift, tandem lift, dual cycling, and other crane-planning methods, subject to vessel design, equipment capability, and safety requirements. Analyze crane intensity, bay gaps, heavy hooks, crane sequences, and workload balance; recommend plan changes to improve crane and berth productivity. Evaluate special and sensitive cargo requirements, including reefer, OOG, IMDG, breakbulk, and direct deliveries, ensuring plans incorporate necessary restrictions. Validate consistency between planning systems, identify data-quality issues, and coordinate corrective actions with IT/TOS and planning stakeholders. Coordinate with Central Planner, Dynamic Vessel Planners, Yard Planners, Operations, and vessel representatives to align optimized plans with yard capacity and terminal strategy. Monitor vessel-plan execution, compare planned versus actual performance, analyze causes of productivity loss, and recommend corrective actions. Support planning for complex vessel calls, major plan changes, and disrupted schedules by assessing alternatives, trade-offs, and risks. Ensure stowage plans, crane plans, and container weight lists (CWL) are reviewed and approved by the Chief Officer and authorized planning representatives. Maintain planning standards, optimization guidelines, analysis records, and vessel-specific lessons learned; coach Dynamic Vessel Planners on planning quality. Support TOS enhancements, planning tools, data-quality improvements, and continuous improvement initiatives. Provide supervisors and management with concise analysis of vessel-plan quality, productivity opportunities, and operational risks. Ensure compliance with HSE policy, Fatal Risk Standards, Safe Work Practices, and relevant SOPs; escalate safety or stability risks immediately. Systematically identify and document available crane-productivity opportunities before vessel arrival. Prepare the loading plan in accordance with approved stowage instructions, ensuring accessible picking points and practical bay sequences. Develop and optimize vessel loading and discharge sequences, balancing crane productivity, cargo priorities, and operational constraints. Act as the planning focal point for coordinating loading and discharge sequences (Quay Commander function, where assigned). Obtain and record the shipping line’s approval of the loading plan before implementation and coordinate any required revisions. Qualifications and Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Maritime Studies, Naval/Marine-related disciplines, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field. Experience: 4+ years in container-terminal operations, including substantial vessel-planning experience and demonstrated capability in complex stowage or crane planning. Work Environment The role requires willingness to work day/night or general shifts, weekends, public holidays, and overtime as required under company policy and applicable labor laws.

cf2481fe55ebcb97.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة عمر عبدالوهاب البدران عن مشرف صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان تطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية ومتابعة الالتزام باللوائح في المنشآت. يتضمن الدور إجراء عمليات التفتيش والتحقيق في الحوادث وإعداد التقارير اللازمة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تطبيق القوانين واللوائح التنظيمية والتعليمات المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية في جميع المنشآت. إجراء عمليات التفتيش الدورية والطارئة في مواقع العمل وتسجيل النتائج ومقارنتها بالمعايير المعتمدة. قياس العوامل البيئية مثل درجة الحرارة والرطوبة والضجيج والاهتزاز باستخدام الأجهزة المتخصصة وتوثيق النتائج. متابعة معالجة الأخطار البيئية الناجمة مع الجهات المختصة لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. تحضير مستلزمات التحقيق في الحوادث والإصابات وإجراء التحقيقات اللازمة وتوثيق النتائج بدقة. إعداد تعليمات وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية، بما في ذلك تعليمات العمل الآمن والإخلاء، وتوعية العاملين بها. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها لضمان الامتثال والتحسين المستمر. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق القوانين واللوائح المتعلقة بالسلامة المهنية. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير والتوثيق. بيئة العمل يعمل مشرف الصحة والسلامة المهنية بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة عمر عبدالوهاب البدران في مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التواجد في مواقع العمل المختلفة لإجراء عمليات التفتيش والتحقيق. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة بعد المقابلة.

cfbac6577c50bdf3.description: نبذة عن الدور يقدم مصرف الراجحي فرصة وظيفية لاستشاري مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقه في المنطقة الشرقية بالمملكة العربية السعودية. يشمل هذا الدور، الذي يتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، العمل بدوام كامل في مدن مثل الدمام، الخبر، الظهران، الجبيل، الأحساء، القطيف، بقيق، راس تنورة، صفوى، الجش، عنك، دارين، العمران، المبرز، والجفر. يركز الدور على تقديم المنتجات والخدمات المصرفية للعملاء بمستوى عالٍ من الجودة والاحترافية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى استشاري المبيعات مجموعة من المهام الأساسية التي تضمن سير العمليات المصرفية بسلاسة وفعالية، مع التركيز على خدمة العملاء وتلبية احتياجاتهم. تشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: استقبال طلبات بيع المنتجات المصرفية ومتابعة إدخالها وتنفيذها على الأنظمة المخصصة. مساعدة العملاء في فتح الحسابات، استيفاء المستندات المطلوبة، إدخال البيانات والتوقيعات في النظام، وطلب تعميد مدير العمليات. ترحيل العقود والحسابات عبر البريد إلى مركز المعلومات وعلى نظام إدارة المستندات (DMS). استقبال العملاء في الفرع وتقديم الخدمة المطلوبة، مع توجيههم لإتمام معاملاتهم بشكل صحيح. مساعدة العملاء في تعبئة النماذج اللازمة وتوجيههم لاستخدام أجهزة الصراف الآلي والقنوات الإلكترونية. الاستجابة السريعة لمشاكل العملاء وتلبية طلباتهم وفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة، والمتابعة مع مراقب الفرع لحل المشكلات. استلام طلبات بطاقات الصراف الآلي، إدخالها في النظام، طباعة البطاقات الفورية، وتسليم البطاقات المجددة. استقبال طلبات تحديث البيانات، قفل الحسابات، وتعديل بيانات الحسابات وتسليمها لمدير العمليات. التعامل مع العملاء الموكلين، استكمال بيانات نماذج التوكيل، مطابقة التوقيعات، وإدخالها في النظام. استيفاء الأوامر المستديمة للعملاء، إنشاء وتنشيط العضويات، وتحويلها لمدير العمليات لاستكمال التنفيذ. التعامل مع طلبات تغيير التوقيع وتحريك الحسابات. إدخال المطالبات المتعلقة بالصراف الآلي ونقاط البيع في نظام مطالبات بطاقات الصراف الآلي. تحويل مشاكل العملاء إلى مدير العمليات للعمل على حلها. الاستعلام عن البطاقات الائتمانية وبطاقات الصراف الآلي المسحوبة في الفرع وتوجيه العملاء لاستلامها. تزويد العملاء بمنشورات المنتجات المصرفية. رفع بلاغات الاشتباه في غسل الأموال وحالات الاحتيال، والإبلاغ عن أي حالات مخالفة للأنظمة والتعليمات. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحين يمتلكون المهارات الأساسية لخدمة العملاء والتعامل مع العمليات المصرفية. يجب أن تتوافر في المتقدمين المؤهلات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع أنظمة إدخال البيانات المصرفية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم خدمة عملاء احترافية. الالتزام بالدقة والاحترافية في إنجاز المهام. بيئة العمل يُعد هذا الدور وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مصرف الراجحي في المنطقة الشرقية، مما يوفر بيئة عمل داعمة ومحفزة لتطوير المهارات المصرفية وخدمة العملاء. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقدم لهذه الفرصة في مصرف الراجحي.

cf3f445136816ffd.description: تعلن شركة كبرى في مجال المقاولات بمدينة الخبر ، عن حاجتها إلى مندوب مبيعات وتسويق. وفق الشروط التالية: 1 - خبرة لا تقل عن 3 سنوات في المجالات أعمال تمديد الكابلات الكهربائية لمحطات تحلية المياه ومعالجة الصرف الصحي، وفي مجال تركيب وصيانة تمديدات خطوط الأنابيب وخزانات الحديد المزجّج (GLS)، بالإضافة إلى المعدات الثابتة والدوارة لمحطات المياه والصرف. يمتلك خبرة فى البحث واستقطاب العملاء و تقديم عروض اسعار و التفاوض مع العملاء 2 - اجادة اللغة الانجليزية 3- ان يكون مقيم فى المنطقة الشرقية

cf175c1a2842d88c.description: SUMMARY OF THE ROLE: As a Sales Coordinator you will be responsible for providing administrative and sales support to the sales and marketing team by assisting with inter-department coordination, supporting the team with day-to-day sales transactions, and providing information when required to ensure that customers’ needs are met, and the department achieves its Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). The position is based in Jeddah and reports to the Area Sales Manager - Projects . Responsibilities: Provide administration and support to the sales team by assisting with daily related Project & Retail sales activities, handling paperwork, proposals and quotations, tenders, bids, and ad hoc duties to ensure efficient sales support is provided for optimum sales results. Support sales staff by following up on DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) collection so that Jotun’s liquidity remains balanced. Coordinate between the Sales Manager, sales personnel, and other internal stakeholders by assisting with communicating and disseminating relevant information. Convey any received external inquiries and information effectively. Coordinate with Customer Service on price variations, customer inquiries, etc., and assist in updating the system price WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR AND WHAT WE OFFER: What We Are Looking For: Qualification: Diploma or bachelor’s degree. 1 - 2 years of relevant experience in Sales Support function. Fluency in Arabic & English – both verbally and written. Location : Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Personal Qualities: Acts on own initiative, makes things happen and accepts responsibility for the results. Builds a useful network of contacts and relationships and utilizes it to achieve objectives Demonstrates specialist knowledge and expertise in own area; participates in continuous professional development Uses a methodical and systematic approach; plans ahead, defines clear priorities and allocates resources effectively. Communicates in a clear, precise and structured way; speaks with authority and conviction; presents effectively. Co-operates well with others; shares knowledge, experience and information; supports others in the pursuit of team goals. We Offer: Competitive compensation and benefits. Continuous learning opportunities and training activities through on-the-job training and our in-house learning Jotun Academy. Career development opportunities across multiple disciplines and geographies. Leaders who focus on engaging and enabling their team, proven by consistently high employee feedback scores. A supportive and inclusive company culture where you can be your authentic self. A focus on having fun together through team buildings and social activities. POSITION INFORMATION: Company: Jotun Saudia Co. Ltd. Contract Type: Regular Time Type: Full time CLOSING DATE (dd.mm.yyyy): 31.10.2026 WHO WE ARE Jotun’s story in the MEIA region (Middle East, India and Africa) began in 1962, and has grown to include 18 legal entities committed to achieving success and growth of the Jotun Group. Throughout our history, we have focused on providing our employees with meaningful and challenging work, rewarding them through continued learning and development, underpinned by our values of Loyalty, Care, Respect and Boldness. Jotun Saudia Co. Ltd., established in 1984, is one of the key markets within the MEIA region. With 2 production facilities, 5 warehouses and more than 450 employees, we aim to further strengthen Jotun’s position in Saudi Arabia through ambitious market growth plans that focus on innovation, efficiency and profitability. Visit our Career Page to know more about life at Jotun. Jotun’s company culture welcomes and values differences in people. Our more than 10,200 employees on all continents represent 90 nationalities, four generations and diversity of professions, gender, abilities, ethnicities, beliefs, cultures etc. We are committed to represent the societies we operate in, promoting equality, equity and zero-tolerance for discrimination. If you are applying to a position and require any additional support in the interview process, please let us know how we can accommodate this. If you think that this role is what you could be doing next, apply now!

cf3a1243951ae333.description: About the Role Toptal is seeking a Vice President, International to lead and expand its Enterprise business across Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia Pacific. This full-time, remote position reports directly to the EVP, Industries, and involves overseeing all international Enterprise sales teams. The role requires a minimum of 10 years of experience and is based in Saudi Arabia, though specific cities are not provided. The Vice President will be accountable for sales results and will work with industry General Managers to tailor approaches for each market. Key Responsibilities Align with industry General Managers on market and client pursuit strategies, offerings, and investment focus, utilizing local market knowledge to develop sales plans. Address obstacles to selling and serving clients in priority geographies by collaborating with Legal, Finance, Operations, and Delivery teams to establish commercially viable arrangements. Be accountable for new-client acquisition, retention, and expansion, working with industry GMs and account teams to grow existing relationships. Build senior client relationships and actively participate in important sales, shaping proposals and leading negotiations. Develop targeted campaigns with Marketing, Sales Development, and industry teams, providing sellers with propositions tailored to local buyers. Identify and secure partners to expand Toptal's reach, defining collaboration terms and evaluating partnerships based on business generation. Guide sellers in recognizing client needs for services or AI-based solutions, bringing in expertise, and coaching teams while ensuring seller ownership of opportunities. Hire and develop strong regional leaders, reviewing their coaching, joining client calls, setting expectations, and addressing underperformance. Establish consistent rhythms for pipeline reviews, forecasting, and account planning, investigating missed targets and managing resources within budgets. Essential Functions and Requirements Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera. Work independently with minimal supervision. Utilize all required digital collaboration tools effectively. Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines. Work effectively with clients and colleagues across various time zones. Travel internationally as needed to develop client and partner relationships and collaborate with teams. Resumes and all communication must be submitted in English. First Year Objectives Deliver against agreed international revenue and sales performance objectives. Demonstrate growth from new clients and expansion within existing accounts, providing evidence to guide future investment decisions. Cultivate regional leaders who effectively coach their teams, address performance issues, and achieve their plans. Application Process Candidates interested in this remote Vice President, International position at Toptal are invited to submit their resumes and all communications in English.

cfcc8abbf6114edf.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة النخلات الثلاث للتجاره عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، وتقدير المواد، ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية بأنواعها (المنزلية، الصناعية، التجارية) ومكوناتها بدقة. تقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة المطلوبة لأعمال التمديدات وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة، مع التأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية وفحصها، بما في ذلك فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض، ومتابعة تشغيل الدارات الكهربائية. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية المختلفة. معرفة جيدة بأنواع المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية ومواصفاتها. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية وتحديد الحلول المناسبة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مكة المكرمة، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لتنفيذ المهام المحددة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

cfc22933f8694724.description: In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next! At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible. Job Description Parsons is looking for a talented Senior Construction Manager to support a Project Management and Construction Management Consultant Services package in Sharma. The role will oversee construction delivery for two residential complexes, including villas, guest and staff villas, gates, boundary walls, demolition, reinstatement, earthworks, drainage, utility diversions, decommissioning, hardscape, softscape, irrigation, and extensive landscaping works. What You’ll Be Doing Manage and supervise construction activities across residential buildings, infrastructure, landscaping, and external works. Ensure construction is delivered in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, contracts, schedules, quality standards, and safety requirements. Lead and coordinate contractors, subcontractors, consultants, site supervision teams, and project stakeholders. Monitor daily site progress, productivity, resources, work fronts, milestones, and construction performance. Review construction methods, method statements, inspection and test plans, temporary works, and work permits. Coordinate demolition of existing structures, earthworks, drainage, utility diversions, decommissioning, and reinstatement activities. Oversee the installation of hardscape, softscape, irrigation systems, landscaping, gates, boundary walls, and associated external works. Identify and resolve construction issues, site constraints, technical queries, RFIs, nonconformances, and interface conflicts. Monitor contractor performance, quality, health and safety, environmental compliance, and adherence to approved schedules. Support testing, commissioning, inspections, handover, snagging, closeout, and final acceptance of the completed works. What Required Skills You’ll Bring Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
